claim: Record drawing commands at the producers' entries after the original has computed its parameters, and replay them in order into a hidden Layer 2 buffer; the original drawing keeps running, so RAM and R parity come free.

evidence.text: Five producer hooks record one command each after the original computes its buffer address, data pointer, rows, shift and mirror; the original mono drawing still runs, so game RAM, registers and R stay the original's, and h_out replays the queue.
evidence.quote: record one command each after the original has computed its buffer address, data pointer, rows, shift and mirror;
